title: OpenCap: Golf Accuracy Qualification Against a Marker Reference
body:
Child 7 of #11400. Depends on #11403 and child 3.

OpenCap was validated on gait, squats and jumps, not on a roughly 0.25 s downswing at 60 fps with motion blur. Compare OpenCap kinematics against a simultaneous marker-based capture of the same swings. Report joint-angle error by phase (backswing, downswing, impact), with the wrists and forearms broken out.

## Acceptance

- A measured error report from a real simultaneous capture.
- **This needs physical capture.** If none is available, record it in the deferred-validation catalog per the fleet rule; never use synthetic numbers as acceptance.
